review_notes: I read all 154 lines of the target file and checked each declaration against its supporting definitions: AddChar/IsPrimitive/mulShift and zmod_char_primitive_of_eq_one_only_at_zero in Mathlib/NumberTheory/LegendreSymbol/AddCharacter.lean, AddCircle.toCircle (including its toCircle_zero/toCircle_add/injective_toCircle and the documented T = 0 convention), Circle.exp/coe_exp/Circle.toUnits, rootsOfUnity as a subgroup of Mˣ with mem_rootsOfUnity'/rootsOfUnityUnitsMulEquiv/restrictRootsOfUnity, Complex.mem_rootsOfUnity and Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity, and HasEnoughRootsOfUnity with MulEquiv.hasEnoughRootsOfUnity/natCard_rootsOfUnity. The statements of toCircle_intCast/natCast/apply, toCircle_eq_circleExp, injective_toCircle, stdAddChar and its formula/injectivity/primitivity, rootsOfUnityAddChar and its val lemma, rootsOfUnitytoCircle, rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv and its apply/value lemmas, the HasEnoughRootsOfUnity Circle instance, surjectivity of the composite, and bijectivity of rootsOfUnityAddChar all match the intended mathematics, and the [NeZero _] hypotheses are genuinely needed (e.g. Complex.mem_rootsOfUnity and norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity require NeZero n, and HasEnoughRootsOfUnity M 0 is unsatisfiable). I could not execute Lean, so the review relies on the stated fact that the file compiles and on reading the cited definitions rather than on re-elaborating the proofs.
